Dev Bhoomi vs Quantum University is a journalism and mass communication comparison with thin data. One side has no fee row, and neither college has a placement or rank.

sections.heading: Dev Bhoomi vs Quantum University for Mass-Communication: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University only after you have an official fee circular, because our table lists Bachelor of Journalism and Mass Communication but has no fee, placement or rank row.
Choose Quantum University if the recorded year tuition of ₹60,500 for Bachelor of Journalism and Mass Communication at the Roorkee campus is acceptable, after official confirmation.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Dev Bhoomi we hold no fee row on this page for Bachelor of Journalism and Mass Communication. Do not invent a fee.
For Quantum University we hold year tuition of ₹60,500 for the same degree name. That is a year figure, not a confirmed official programme total.
Confirm the current notices on dbuu.ac.in and quantumuniversity.edu.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither college has a placement row on this page for mass communication.
Ask both campuses for an official internship or placement note if media training outcomes matter to you.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each university's official undergraduate admissions process.
Our table has no ranking rows for either college in this comparison.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Dev Bhoomi is recorded in Dehradun. Quantum University is recorded in Roorkee, even though its profile slug mentions Dehradun. They are not the same city.
Both are private universities and both list BJMC. Visit the studios and labs you would actually use.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Dev Bhoomi if the Dehradun campus is the offer you want, after you have a written official fee.
Pick Quantum University if the Roorkee campus and the recorded ₹60,500 year tuition fit you, after official confirmation.
This page has no placement or rank data to break the tie.
